metadata.title: How Ribosomes Read mRNA
metadata.audience: practitioners and makers following the channel; smart non-biologists
metadata.greeting_note: hello lexicon: Jambo (Swahili, one word). Liam never takes Wagwan.
metadata.note: User brief: 60 s, 12 beats, Kokoro am_onyx, review cut only. Body narration is far under the skill's 45-70 word budget because of the 60 s brief; logged in BUILD-LOG.md. Example sequence used throughout: 5'-AUG GCU GGC UAA-3' = Met-Ala-Gly-stop (standard genetic code).
metadata.kokoro_speed_note: generate_audio_kokoro.py has no beat-sheet speed field; always regenerate with --speed 1.1 to match this cut.

beats.role_note: COLD OPEN LAW — Claude UI, ask lands answered; IN-FOR-BEAR.
beats.narration_text: Jambo, this is Liam, in for Bear. How do ribosomes read messenger RNA?

show.event: composer card fades in on cream
greeting 'Jambo, Liam' above the composer
the ask types in
runningText 'reading the genetic code…' appears
three answer lines cascade in

props.command: How does a ribosome actually read mRNA?
output: mRNA is read three letters at a time, from AUG
tRNA anticodons do the decoding; the ribosome checks the fit
ribosomal RNA links each amino acid into the chain

beats.role_note: EXECUTIVE-SUMMARY LAW — hesitant writer. Correction = the reel's misconception: the ribosome is not the reader; tRNA base-pairing is.
beats.narration_text: A ribosome doesn't read the code by itself. Small adapters called transfer RNAs do the reading. The ribosome holds the tape, checks every fit, and links the growing chain.

show.event: cream page holds; caret blinks
first lines type: 'A ribosome / reads the code.'
'reads' turns terracotta, hesitates, backspaces, types 'lets tRNA read'
final line settles: 'A ribosome / lets tRNA read the code.'

beats.role_note: FRAMEWORK beat — the three parts on screen before any example.
beats.narration_text: Three parts: a messenger tape, transfer RNA carriers, and a ribosome with three slots.
beats.visual_intent: The machine assembles in narration order: the mRNA tape draws on, a tRNA with its amino-acid bead drops in, the two ribosome subunits close over the tape and the E, P, A slots label themselves.

show.event: 5'-AUG GCU GGC UAA-3' tape draws on, labelled mRNA
a tRNA carrying a Met bead drops in from above, labelled tRNA
large and small subunits slide together around the tape
slots E, P, A outline and label left to right

beats.role_note: Codons + start codon. Brackets group the tape in threes; AUG lights as the start.
beats.narration_text: It reads in threes, called codons, starting at A U G, which brings methionine.
beats.visual_intent: A bracket steps along the tape grouping letters in threes; it returns to AUG, which turns terracotta, and a Met bead appears above it.

show.event: brackets mark AUG | GCU | GGC | UAA one after another
AUG highlights terracotta; label 'start codon'
Met bead rises above AUG

beats.role_note: WORKED EXAMPLE through the framework: wrong tRNA rejected, matching tRNA accepted in slot A.
beats.narration_text: A carrier tries slot A. If its anticodon pairs with the codon, it stays.
beats.visual_intent: Close-up of slot A over codon GCU. A tRNA with anticodon UAC docks; its letters fail to pair (crosses) and it leaves. A tRNA with anticodon CGA docks; three pairing ticks appear and it locks in, carrying Ala.

show.event: tRNA with anticodon UAC drops onto codon GCU; three crosses; it lifts away
tRNA with anticodon CGA drops in; G-C, C-G, U-A pair lines appear
slot A outline turns terracotta; Ala bead settles

beats.role_note: Peptidyl transfer — catalysed by ribosomal RNA.
beats.narration_text: The ribosome's own RNA links the new amino acid to the chain.
beats.visual_intent: Met (on the tRNA in slot P) moves across and bonds to Ala (on the tRNA in slot A); a bond line draws; label 'catalyst: ribosomal RNA'.

show.event: Met bead slides from the P tRNA onto Ala; bond line draws
label 'catalyst: ribosomal RNA' writes under the large subunit

beats.role_note: Translocation: ribosome moves one codon toward 3'; empty tRNA exits from E.
beats.narration_text: Then everything shifts one codon. The empty carrier exits, and slot A opens.
beats.visual_intent: The ribosome slides three letters right along the tape; the empty tRNA ends in E and floats away; slot A sits empty over GGC.

show.event: ribosome slides one codon right; tRNAs stay paired to their codons
empty tRNA in E lifts off and fades
empty slot A over GGC pulses

beats.role_note: FALSIFIABILITY: the strict-pairing model breaks at codon position 3. One tRNA-Gly (anticodon 5'-GCC-3') reads GGC and GGU via G-U wobble.
beats.narration_text: Pairing is loose at letter three: G G U and G G C both mean glycine.
beats.visual_intent: One Gly tRNA pairs with GGC (strict), then slides to GGU: the third pair bends into a wobble pair while the first two stay strict. Both codons point to Gly.

show.event: the third letter of codon and anticodon highlight terracotta
the same tRNA moves from GGC to GGU; the third pair becomes a wobble pair
both codons point to one Gly bead

beats.role_note: Termination: no tRNA for stop codons; a release factor (a protein) binds.
beats.narration_text: No transfer RNA fits the stop codons. A release factor frees the chain.
beats.visual_intent: Slot A over UAA; tRNAs approach and bounce off; a release-factor block docks instead; the Met-Ala-Gly chain detaches and drifts up.

show.event: stop codons UAA UAG UGA listed; a tRNA approaches UAA and bounces off
release-factor block docks in slot A
Met-Ala-Gly chain detaches and rises

beats.role_note: VERDICT artifact — the whole mechanism in order.
beats.narration_text: Read in threes, decoded by pairing, linked by RNA, ended by a protein.

show.event: artifact card in on cream
heading: 'How ribosomes read mRNA'
line 1 in
line 2 in
line 3 in
line 4 in

artifactLines: Read in threes — codons, from the AUG start
Decoded by pairing — tRNA anticodons, loose at letter three
Linked by RNA — ribosomal RNA forms each peptide bond
Ended by a protein — release factors read UAA, UAG, UGA
